summary: Creamy brown beans simmered with palm oil, onions, pepper and smoked fish into a thick, savoury porridge.
story: Beans porridge is an everyday Nigerian one-pot meal, eaten at home for lunch or dinner and sold at roadside canteens. It is often served with fried plantain, bread or garri.

items.name: Ripe plantain
items.note: optional, cubed, cooked in the beans for sweetness

steps.title: Boil the beans
steps.text: Put the beans, chopped onion and water in a large pot and bring to a boil. Reduce to a simmer, partly covered, and cook for 45 to 60 minutes (or about 25 minutes in a pressure cooker). The beans should be about 70 percent soft at this stage.

steps.title: Skim and top up
steps.text: Skim off any foam that rises and add hot water if the level falls below the beans. Cold water slows cooking.

steps.title: Blend the peppers
steps.text: Blend the bell pepper, scotch bonnet and the remaining onion until smooth and pour into the pot.

steps.title: Add flavour
steps.text: Stir in the palm oil, crayfish, smoked fish, cubes and plantain if using. Season lightly with salt, as the fish and cubes add salt too.

steps.title: Simmer to a porridge
steps.text: Cook uncovered for 25 to 30 minutes, stirring occasionally. The beans are done when completely soft and the broth turns creamy and thick, with oil floating on top.

steps.title: Mash and thicken
steps.text: Mash a ladleful of beans against the side of the pot and stir them back in to thicken the porridge. Adjust salt and let it rest for 5 minutes before serving.

tips: Never add salt at the start: it can toughen beans.
Add hot water, not cold, while the beans cook.
Soak the beans overnight to shorten cooking and reduce gas.
Keep the palm oil added later so it does not boil away its flavour.

swaps.swap: Black-eyed peas cook faster, in about 35 minutes, and taste a little milder.
Smoked turkey or a little flaked tinned mackerel work as well. Omit for a vegan version.
Use vegetable oil plus 1/2 tsp smoked paprika. The flavour will be lighter.

name: Nigerian Beans Porridge
